pairing_timeout.description:
The device did not enter pairing mode. Click Submit to try again.

### Troubleshooting
1. Check that the device is not connected to the Ooler mobile app.
2. Unplug the device for 5 seconds, then plug it back in.

progress.wait_for_pairing_mode:
To complete setup, put this device in pairing mode.

### How to enter pairing mode
1. Force quit the Ooler mobile app.
2. Press and hold the power button on the device. Release when the Bluetooth icon starts blinking (approximately 5 seconds).

stuck_setpoint_unfixable.title: Ooler {address} keeps discarding its temperature
stuck_setpoint_unfixable.description:
The Ooler at **{address}** has a firmware fault that makes it discard the temperature you set and revert to an older value shortly after it powers off. This is triggered by letting a deep clean cycle run all the way to completion. Home Assistant detected the problem and tried to correct it automatically several times, but the fix did not hold.

## What to do

1. On the unit itself, start a deep clean cycle and then **cancel it after about 10 seconds** — do not let it finish. A completed clean is what causes this; a cancelled one clears it.
2. Set your temperature again and wait a few minutes to confirm it holds (the revert can take up to a minute to appear).
3. Avoid running deep cleans to completion on this unit.

If the problem persists after these steps, please report it at the [issue tracker](https://github.com/PostLogical/ooler/issues). This notification clears automatically if the device starts behaving again.
